title: Suum Cuique: Studying Bias in Taboo Detection with a Community Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Training community-specific language classification models (CLCs) for five minority communities (African American, South Asian, Native American, Hispanic, Hawaiian) and measuring the Pearson correlation between taboo classifier confidence scores and the communities' text alignment scores.

Calculating the proportion of taboo-labeled texts in standard datasets that highly align with community-specific linguistic models, and conducting user studies with community members to evaluate misclassifications of benign, community-normative language.
